title: Point of view / perspective Practice 1
description: 4 short texts - 8 focused point of view / perspective questions
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Bike Lanes

A delivery driver says a protected bike lane may make curb access harder during busy hours. A cyclist says the same lane separates riders from moving traffic. The article reports both views.

TEXT B - Rainy Morning

I had packed my notes in a plastic folder, but by the time I reached the bus stop my shoes were soaked. I could see the driver waving from across the intersection, yet I had no idea whether he would wait.

TEXT C - School Garden

A teacher values the garden as an outdoor science lab. A maintenance worker supports it but worries about irrigation during school holidays.

TEXT D - Historic Market

A planner calls new lighting and drainage practical improvements. A resident says the renovation should also protect the market's familiar wooden stalls.
